title: Coffee Ice Cream
description: A smooth, creamy no-churn coffee ice cream made from espresso, condensed milk and evaporated milk. Whisked and frozen for a scoopable result.

ingredients.text: 1 espresso (3 tsp instant coffee + 2 tsp boiling water)
200g sweetened condensed milk (roughly half a tin)

steps: Line a 1-litre freezer-safe container with cling film.
Make the espresso and allow to cool slightly. Stir into the condensed milk in a large bowl.
Pour in the evaporated milk. Whisk on the highest setting for 5–6 minutes until bubbly and pale.
Tip into the container, fold the cling film over and seal.
Freeze for 3 hours, then take out and stir through. Return to freezer for another 3 hours or overnight.
Take out 20 minutes before serving to soften slightly.
notes: Serves 6. Keeps in the freezer for a few months.
